rationale: Price is in a clean intraday uptrend above VWAP ($18.38) and the 9-EMA ($18.65), holding a tight ~7-cent coil pinned directly at the high of day, with the largest recent volume bar closing at its high — buyers are absorbing supply at 18.78 while SPY is down 0.66%, a strong relative-strength divergence on 4.55x relative volume.
